research_scope: Targeted 7/30/90 day public HF, developer publication, Github and arXiv discovery; not exhaustive. Two OCR repos predate 30 days by creation, updated Oct29. Nandi public announcement Nov24; no observed access restriction change verified. Xiaomi arXiv metadata identified; full paper not retrieved.

decisions.reason: Independent pruned and distilled student of 450M, publisher 500B training tokens; complete BF16 MLM state with untied head, 16k context; low-resource multilingual classification/NER adaptation and teacher-student compression comparison. Not a quantization and no teacher weight required for inference.
decisions.positive: Publisher Indic 7-task mean 67.37 vs IndicBERT-v2 66.57; 5/7 tasks better; English 10-task mean 62.20 vs ModernBERT-base 60.69 (fixed card).
decisions.negative: Publisher slot filling 54 vs 58.1 and QA 46 vs 48.3 for IndicBERT-v2; English mean 62.20 vs UltraBERT-150M 64.59; blog narrative differs from fixed card. Not Japanese; no owner matched hardware replication.
decisions.next_gate: matched multilingual adaptation, reviewed custom code and ABI, individual rights, local SHA and storage

decisions.reason: Separate from-scratch multilingual encoder trained on publisher 1.1T tokens, 32k context, teacher baseline for student distillation. Distinct trained state and long-context/quality reference for Indic NLP; not an alternative precision file.
decisions.positive: Publisher Indic 7-task mean 73.23 vs IndicBERT-v2 65.93; 7/7 tasks better. English 10-task mean 63.34 vs existing ModernBERT-large 61.02 (fixed card).
decisions.negative: Publisher GLUE 89.9 vs ModernBERT-large 90.4; SQuAD2 89.7 vs 89.8; English mean 63.34 vs UltraBERT-380M 66.79. Not Japanese; independent replication, hardware and variance unavailable.
decisions.next_gate: matched multilingual adaptation, reviewed custom code and ABI, individual rights, local SHA and storage

decisions.reason: Independent OCR-centric continued training and verifiable RL, but current OCR specialists overlap. Publisher OCR 5-task mean 83.2 vs Qwen3.5-0.8B 72.9; 4B 84.9; OmniDocBench 96.83 vs TeleOCR 96.87; Wild 87.94 vs 88.53. Real5 comparison against PaddleOCR 1.6 not existing 1.5. No direct matched comparison with LightOnOCR-3, PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 and DeepSeek-OCR-2. Apache-2.0 tag; LICENSE absent; upstream rights unverified.
